name: Gray Biohacker
body:
GRAY BIOHACKER
CR 1/2

XP 200
Gray biohacker 1
NE Small humanoid (gray)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 13, flat-footed 13 (+1 size, +2 Dex, +2 armor)
hp 9 (1d8+1)
Fort +3, Ref +2, Will +1
Defensive Abilities phase (1/day); Weaknesses mute

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee masterwork dagger +0 (1d3 P or S plus blue whinnis poison, 19–20/×2)
Ranged injection pistol +2 (1d3 P plus biohack)
Special Attacks biohacks (5/day)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 1st; concentration +5)

1/day—mind thrust I
At will—daze

STATISTICS

Str 8 (–1), Dex 14 (+2), Con 13 (+1), Int 19 (+4), Wis 12 (+1), Cha 8 (–1)
Base Atk +0; CMB –2; CMD 10
Feats Point-Blank Shot, Technologist (B)
Skills Bluff +3, Craft (alchemy) +8, Heal +9, Knowledge (local, nature) +8, Perception +6, Sense Motive +6, Stealth +7
Languages Aklo, Common, 3 others (can’t speak); limited telepathy
SQ custom microlab, injection expert, primary field of study (neurochemistry), scientific method (studious)
Gear carbonfiber armor, masterwork dagger, needler pistol, 40 needler darts, 2 doses of blue whinnis poison

ABOUT

The grays are a mysterious species of aliens who communicate only through telepathy.

They are known for abducting other humanoids and performing sinister biological experiments. Their motivations remain completely inscrutable, and they have no diplomatic ties or social interaction with other species. They show little outward expression or emotion. They move with an unsettling gate, and appear much like waifish, gray-skinned human children with oversized heads that are nearly featureless save for tiny mouths and dull, black eyes.

The biohacker presented here is typical of a low-level gray agent. A creature such as this may be found acting alone, but is more likely to be found supporting a group of one or more standard grays.
